batches.B1: KerML structure: owned relationships, flags and metaclass of resolved targets
batches.B2: SysML structure: memberships, owning types, variations, referential flags, reference subsettings
batches.B3: Effective typing: 'must be typed by' rules over all types of a feature (getAllTypesOf)
batches.B4: Derived feature semantics: featuring types, multiplicities, ends, cross features, redefinition/subsetting conformance, connectors, inherited parameters and memberships, library specialization
batches.B5: Names: namespace distinguishability (member names, alias names, inherited memberships)
batches.B6: Expression typing and evaluation: Boolean/Integer/Duration/Time results, model-level evaluability, cast and binding type conformance, implicit binding connectors
